title: DNA extraction for HMW DNA
author: Natalie Solonenko
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6cbhasn

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer and add
steps.instruction: Make the lysis buffer and add 600 µL to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Make lysis buffer by adding 300 µL 20 % SDS and 60 µL 20 mg/mL proteinase K to 10 mL 1X TE.
Add 600 µL lysis buffer to ≤500 µL sample in a 2 mL tube.

steps.title: First phenol:chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add one volume of phenol:chloroform, mix by inversion (in a fume hood).

steps.title: Repeat phenol:chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add a second equal volume of phenol:chloroform, mix by inversion (in a fume hood).

steps.title: Chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add one volume of chloroform, mix by inversion (in a fume hood).

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add ice‑cold absolute ethanol to fill the tube to 2.5–3 volumes total, mix by inversion.

steps.title: Ethanol rinse pellet
steps.instruction: Rinse the pellet with 1 mL room‑temperature 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous layer
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the aqueous layer and transfer it to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous layer again
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous layer to another new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Cold precipitation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at –20 °C for more than 30 minutes (longer incubation improves DNA precipitation but also co‑precipitates salts).

steps.title: Spin pellet at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed for 15 minutes at 4 °C; then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Quick spin at RT
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Air‑dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the DNA pellet at room temperature (or faster at 40 °C) while avoiding over‑drying.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL warm nuclease‑free water; do not vortex or pipet—gently flick the tube and let stand at room temperature up to 4 hours, store at 4 °C overnight and flick again; if difficult, incubate at 56 °C with periodic flicking until dissolved.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration (e.g., Qubit) and purity (e.g., NanoDrop); ensure the pellet is fully resuspended before analysis.
